content_system_application.question_unit: How do I create or repair a Markdown table without losing the meaning of spreadsheet fields?
content_system_application.solution_unit: Define columns, paste supported Excel or CSV material, normalize separators, then review semantic edge cases before saving.

relationship_to_existing_pages.duplicate_decision: Distinct task intent; not a near-duplicate of general document conversion.

transmission_review.silence_spiral: The audience is tired of pasting spreadsheets into tools that break structure or lock it in proprietary formats.
uses_and_gratifications: social capital when sharing clean documents
transmission_review.framing: Stand with people who need the table to remain portable and reviewable, not with a tool that owns the data.
transmission_review.two_step_flow: First communicators are technical writers, researchers, analysts, and course maintainers who exchange source files.
transmission_review.cognitive_consistency: Confirm that Markdown should stay canonical while challenging the habit of skipping header, blank-value, and merged-cell review.
transmission_review.avoid: No productivity hype, no claim of perfect conversion, and no implication that cloud processing is required.

evidence: The Markdown Tables family targets a distinct high-frequency task rather than duplicating document conversion.
All four localized pages expose unique titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, hreflang sets, FAQPage, HowTo, and BreadcrumbList entities.
Home, workflow, download, sitemap, llms.txt, and localized full-corpus surfaces link the new canonical paths.
Visual table construction is tied to the documented ReadMD table designer.
Excel and CSV paste conversion is stated with a review boundary for headers, delimiters, line breaks, and field order.
The pages explicitly distinguish in-memory display repairs from an explicit edit-and-save action and do not claim native support for every merged-cell pattern.
Website validator passes 40 canonical URLs, including four new localized table answers, with three recorded approval rounds.
Release build validation passes after the expanded corpus and sitemap are copied into dist.
Browser smoke passes all 40 routes with zero failures, zero broken images, matching PNG social metadata, and four verified table routes.

conditions: Production check must verify all forty canonical routes before deployment is considered complete.
IndexNow resubmission must follow a successful production check.
